bear.thesis_summary: The trade fails because the mean-reversion thesis relies on three independent signals that are either contradicted by smart-money flow or structurally unreliable in isolation. RSI 24.92 is oversold but MACD is bearish and price is below the 200DMA — a classic "falling knife" structure where oversold readings persist or deepen. HV Rank 1/100 signals volatility compression, not direction; low vol often precedes further drift, not a bounce. The Sentinel net bias +12 (Long 23/Short 11) is a model output with no disclosed lookback or regime conditioning — its edge is unvalidated. Critically, FII 30-day flow of ₹-930.9 Cr shows sustained institutional selling, directly opposing the long thesis. PCR 0.999 is neutral, offering no confirmation. With no OI data, no dealer mode, and no Monte Carlo base rate, the bull case has no quantified floor — it is a narrative built on oversold optics while smart money exits.
